concerns.text: T013 (evaluation pipeline) lacks a CPU‑only guard; it may invoke CUDA if the baseline TinyLlama or the distilled T5 model detects a GPU, violating Constitution Principle VI and FR‑008 (resource‑constraint).
T014 (ablation pipeline) also omits a CUDA‑availability check, similarly breaching the CPU‑only inference constraint.
T012 (model training) does not explicitly set or record a random seed, and the seed is not propagated to downstream scripts, breaking SC‑001 reproducibility and Constitution Principle I.
T010 (extraction) reads the power‑analysis result but does not set a deterministic seed for any stochastic operations (e.g., shuffling), further compromising reproducibility.

T007 implements power analysis using `statsmodels.stats.power.GofChisquarePower`, which is designed for chi‑square tests, not the McNemar paired test required by FR‑007; this weakens the methodological validity of the a‑priori power calculation.
